Argylebuild/ML2-Installer.name: Argyle Build for Magic Leap 2 v2.2.0
Argylebuild/ML2-Installer.body:
## What's New

• Improved rendering distance for better visibility of distant structures and project elements
• Fixed crashes in text rendering and corrected line weight display for more accurate blueprint visualization
• Enhanced model pipeline for faster and more reliable asset loading on job sites

## Changes since v2.1.1

- render distance improved (a422631)
- render fixes (texter crash and line weight) (113528c)
- combined model pipeline and ryo updates (c00d008)

Argylebuild/Revit-Installer.name: Argyle Revit Plugin v2.2.0
Argylebuild/Revit-Installer.body:
## What's New

# Release Notes - v2.0.6

- **Improved Project Management**: The user interface now hides projects you don't have write access to, reducing confusion and streamlining project selection
- **Enhanced CAD Import**: Added comprehensive line handling and improved support for CAD file imports
- **Better Data Export**: Texture support now included in exports, providing more complete model representation
- **Bug Fixes**: Resolved issues with duplicate API data and improved compatibility with older project manifests

## Changes since v2.0.5

- Matching navis in submodule (1578bea)
- Dedicated revit signer (087d837)
- fixed doubles in api data (b1b337a)
- old bug fix. Still testing textures (8648bc4)
- added texture to export (c1b8047)
- lines round 2 for CAD import added. (b7669f9)
- added line handling (0abb308)
- updating to latest (deb889b)
- preventing error from confusing old manifests (5379a5f)
- Bump actions/checkout from 6 to 7 (068bd7b)
- user interface no longer lists project that can't be written to (8f32485)

Argylebuild/Navisworks-Installer.name: Argyle Navisworks Add-in v2.2.1
Argylebuild/Navisworks-Installer.body:
## What's New

# Release Notes - Version 2.2.1

• **Enhanced Export Functionality** – Improved logging during export operations to better diagnose and resolve issues on job sites

• **Publishing Improvements** – Added new filter options to the publish feature for greater control over data synchronization

## Changes since v2.2.0

- added filter and debug to options to publish (7ca7cac)
- building temp for customer testing (6925a00)
- Added big logging for export to troubleshoot on customer side. (ceb15a2)
